in_sanskrit.name: Asmarth
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Lord of the mind
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Asmarth एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Asmarth is derived from the Sanskrit words ‘as’ meaning 'to' and ‘smartha’ meaning 'mind'. This name signifies one who is the lord of the mind, and is often used for boys in Hindu culture.
